archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) + Archetype 1 (Warm Beige/Earthy) Hybrid. Vibe: High-End Enterprise Finance / Old Money Tech

rules: Use tracking-tight for all headings above 32px to create a structured, authoritative feel.
Tabular nums MUST be used for all financial data (JetBrains Mono) to ensure vertical alignment in tables and KPI tiles.
Overlines and table headers must be uppercase, text-xs, tracking-widest (e.g., tracking-[0.2em]).
Do not use bold for everything. Use medium (font-medium) for standard emphasis and black (font-black) for large KPI numbers.
Background is a very soft warm off-white (Alabaster), not pure white.
Surfaces (cards, modals) are pure white for maximum data clarity.
Accent color (Matte Gold/Bronze) should be used sparingly for active states, selected tabs, and primary action buttons. Never use large gold gradients.
Status colors are muted and deep (Forest Green, Terracotta Red) to avoid the 'cheap SaaS' neon look.

spacing_and_layout.card_style: Flat background, 1px solid border-border, no shadow. Hover state: shadow-sm, -translate-y-px.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-sm (2px) or rounded-none. Maintain sharp, authoritative corners.
rules: Implement the 'Control Room' grid for the dashboard. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
Every pixel must be utilized in grids. Ensure h-full on children for uniform height.
Optical alignment: Add extra padding to visually center text if an element has a leading icon.

components.buttons: Flat, sharp corners (rounded-sm). Primary buttons use bg-[#111110] text-white hover:bg-[#A67C00] transition-colors. Secondary buttons are transparent with 1px border.
components.kpi_tiles: F-pattern layout. 1px solid border. Clickable with hover effect: border-[#A67C00] and a subtle gold arrow icon appearing. Numbers must be in JetBrains Mono, text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tighter.
components.stage_tracker: Horizontal segmented pipeline (Pipeline → Deal P&L → Customer PO → Operations → Closure). Use sharp rectangular blocks instead of rounded pills. Active stage gets a 2px bottom border in gold (#A67C00).
components.data_tables: Dense, highly functional. 1px bottom border per row. Hover effect on rows: bg-[#FAFAF8]. Use sticky headers for large datasets. Align financial numbers to the right.
components.upload_engine: Drag-and-drop zone using the 'Tracing Beam' concept or a dashed 2px border (#E5E5E0) that turns solid gold (#A67C00) on drag-over. Soft beige background on hover.
components.currency_toggle: Small segmented control (₹ Crore / $ Million) placed in the top right of the dashboard header. Tactile neumorphism: background matches header, active state has white bg and 1px border.
components.sidebar: Dark slate/charcoal (#111110) sidebar with white/gold text for high contrast against the light dashboard. Links hover state: bg-white/10 text-[#D4AF37].

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must have a defined hover state. Button background changes, card borders highlight.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use fast, snappy transitions (e.g., transition-all duration-200 ease-out) to match the enterprise efficiency vibe.
motion_and_interactions.loading_states: Avoid generic spinners. Use skeleton loaders with a subtle shimmer effect (bg-gradient) for data grids and KPI tiles.

media_and_icons.icon_style: Duotone or thin line weights to match the crisp, elegant aesthetic.

image_urls.description: A striking minimalist photo of a modern architectural facade against a dark sky. Use on the left side of the split login screen (50w) with a bg-black/30 overlay.
Modern glass skyscrapers with reflective surfaces. Use at very low opacity (10%) or as a watermarked background for empty state screens.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards. Gold accent text must only be used on dark backgrounds; on light backgrounds, use it for borders/icons, not small text.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='kpi-revenue-tile').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required font libraries or use Google Fonts (Cabinet Grotesk, Work Sans, JetBrains Mono).
Build the dashboard using pure HTML/Tailwind for the structural layout to ensure the 'Control Room' grid is strictly followed.
Use Shadcn UI for complex interactive components (Tables, Dropdowns, Dialogs, Select), but OVERRIDE their default border-radius to rounded-sm or rounded-none to match this enterprise-grade guideline.
Implement the split-screen login page using the 'login_hero' image on the left and the auth form on the right.
Ensure the Indian/US currency toggle logic handles the formatting correctly (₹ Lakhs/Crores vs $ Millions).
